answer:
Here is what I would raise at your check-up, most urgent first. Your records run from February 2024 to a download dated 15 October 2026, so anything after that is not something I can see.

1. Your stool test in November 2025 was positive. I cannot find a colonoscopy or other look at the bowel after it. A positive stool test normally needs a colonoscopy to find the cause, and that result is now nearly a year old. Please ask about this first.

2. Your diabetes control. Your last HbA1c was 6.9% on 16 February 2026. It peaked at 8.3% in January 2025 and has come down since. There is no HbA1c on file after February. Checks are usually every 3 to 6 months, so one is due now.

3. Your diabetes medicines do not line up in the records. Metformin is marked as finished on 15 April 2024. The next diabetes medicine on file is Jardiance (empagliflozin), prescribed on 20 February 2025. Your HbA1c kept rising during that gap. Please confirm which diabetes medicines you take now, and whether metformin was stopped on purpose.

4. Cholesterol. Your LDL was 131 mg/dL (high) on 18 February 2025. Atorvastatin 20 mg was prescribed two days later. I cannot find any cholesterol test since then. A recheck is normally done a few weeks to 3 months after starting a statin.

5. The lung clot scare in July 2025 was ruled out. A CT scan showed no pulmonary embolism, and the clot entry is marked as refuted, which is correct. Your D-dimer blood test was raised that day, and I cannot find a repeat test. Ask that the clot is not kept as a real diagnosis, and ask whether the raised D-dimer needs anything further.

6. Your kidney function is in the normal range. eGFR was 69 on 16 February 2026 (60 or above is normal), and creatinine and potassium were normal. This matters for Jardiance and metformin, so it is worth checking each year.

7. I cannot find a urine albumin test anywhere in your records. It is the yearly kidney check for people with diabetes. It may simply not be in these files, so ask whether it has been done.
short: Positive stool test in November 2025 with no colonoscopy on file, HbA1c due (last 6.9% in February 2026), and metformin stopped in April 2024 with Jardiance from February 2025, which needs reconciling. LDL 131 in February 2025 with no cholesterol recheck since starting atorvastatin.
